info.name: VideoGame Platform - IGDB Exploration
info.description: Development-only provider reference. Current and hypothetical future needs; not the product contract or an approved backlog. Read igdb-exploration.md. Use the IGDB environment and private credentials; run lookups before dependent requests. No automatic token acquisition, crawling, payload persistence or retries.

exec: for (const [key, fallback] of Object.entries({igdbNowEpoch: now, igdbFromEpoch: now - 30 * 86400, igdbToEpoch: now + 90 * 86400})) {
if (!pm.variables.get(key)) reject('Set ' + key + ' privately in the IGDB environment before sending.');
if (!Number.isInteger(pageSize) || pageSize < 1 || pageSize > 50) reject('Exploration page size must be 1..50.');
if (!value) reject('Resolve ' + key + ' using the lookup described on this request.');
if (!/^\d+(,\d+)*$/.test(value) || value.split(',').length > pageSize) reject(key + ' must contain at most pageSize comma-separated numeric IDs.');
if (/["\\;\r\n]/.test(value)) reject('Use a simple search term without query delimiters.');
} else if (!/^\d+$/.test(value)) reject(key + ' must be an unsigned integer.');
if (body.includes('igdbFromEpoch') && Number(pm.variables.get('igdbFromEpoch')) >= Number(pm.variables.get('igdbToEpoch'))) reject('Date window must be increasing.');
if (body.includes('igdbNowEpoch') && Number(pm.variables.get('igdbNowEpoch')) >= Number(pm.variables.get('igdbToEpoch'))) reject('Upcoming upper date must be later than now.');
pm.test('IGDB HTTP 200 (401: renew token; 429: reduce request rate)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Records expose numeric provider IDs', () => rows.forEach(row => pm.expect(row.id).to.be.a('number')));

item.name: Core game data
item.description: Start with the complete card. IDs below belong to IGDB, never to the product API.

request.description:
A focused detail card using Expander. Media, release rows and relationship lists are separate bounded queries. Default game: The Witcher 3 (1942). No fields wildcard.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Durations are seconds. Inspect count before presenting an estimate; an empty response means no evidence.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Default: Portal 2 (72). Platform-specific capabilities are richer than game_modes; missing fields are not evidence of false.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

item.name: Releases
item.description: Keep platform, region, precision and status on the same release row. Date windows are UTC and upper-exclusive.

request.description:
Window defaults to 30 days ago through 90 days ahead. Override epoch seconds in the environment. ID order makes offset exploration deterministic; inspect date rather than assuming chronological order.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Default platform: PC (6). Includes approximate dates; date_format is essential. This explores provider evidence, not product release eligibility.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Run release-region lookup first and set igdbReleaseRegionId; it is a reference ID, not the old region enum.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Copy the chosen region ID into igdbReleaseRegionId. Localization regions are a different resource.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

fields id,region;
sort id asc; limit {{igdbPageSize}}; offset {{igdbOffset}};

item.name: Ratings and popularity
item.description: Provider scores and popularity are separate from VideoGame Platform personal/aggregate ratings.

item.name: Game age classifications - PEGI and ESRB

request.description:
Expander retrieves available organizations including PEGI/ESRB without assuming old category/rating enums.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Copy comma-separated age-rating IDs from the expanded game response to igdbAgeRatingIds. There is no game field on age_ratings.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Resolve PEGI/ESRB organization reference IDs.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

body.raw:
fields id,name;
sort id asc; limit {{igdbPageSize}};

request.description:
rating here is the current category label; age_ratings.rating is deprecated.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

body.raw:
fields id,organization.name,rating;
sort id asc; limit {{igdbPageSize}}; offset {{igdbOffset}};

request.description:
Show counts with scores; these provider scores must never replace product-owned rating statistics.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Copy a type ID into igdbPopularityTypeId. Visits, want-to-play and playing are signals, not personalized recommendations.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

body.raw:
fields id,name,external_popularity_source.name;
sort id asc; limit {{igdbPageSize}};

request.description:
Resolve returned game_id integers in the next request. Rank ties have no promised stable paging: this snapshot deliberately has no offset.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Copy at most igdbPageSize comma-separated game_id values to igdbPopularGameIds. Returned order is by ID, not rank; retain primitive scores when comparing.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

item.name: Relationships
item.description: Explore optional relationships without changing approved import eligibility.

request.description:
Copy collection/franchise IDs to their variables. Singular franchise is current; singular collection is deprecated.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

A series/collection and a franchise are different concepts. Query members via games to avoid expanding a growing games array.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Resolve from the game references first; a game need not belong to a franchise.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Bounded member listing rather than collections.games.name expansion.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Includes primary and additional franchise memberships.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

item.name: DLC, expansions, remakes, remasters and ports

request.description:
Single-game inspection of relation arrays; root limit does not cap expanded children. For growing child lists use the next parent query. Remakes/remasters/ports may be absent for this sample.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Shows parent-linked records. This is not a universal inverse of every remake/remaster/port relation.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Provider-supplied similarity is a discovery hypothesis. Root limit does not limit this relation array or guarantee relevance.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Inspect type labels to distinguish official sites, stores and communities; a trusted flag is not a licensing grant.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Current reference table replaces websites.category.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

sort id asc; limit {{igdbPageSize}};

uid is an external service ID, not product identity or purchase availability evidence.

item.name: Discovery and search
item.description: Search results require identity review before selecting a game or edition.

request.description:
Default term: The Witcher. Excludes editions, not DLC/remakes. Inspect type/platform/year before changing igdbGameId. Search strings must contain no quotes or backslashes.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Default term: Sonic. Mixed result resources may omit game; choose games search when only game identity is needed.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

item.name: Advanced queries
item.description: Manual pages and independent batched needs; no automatic crawl or retries.

request.description:
Set igdbAfterGameId to the last returned ID for the next page. ID cursor avoids deep offsets but does not freeze mutable provider data.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

Four independent queries in one round trip. Results are named arrays, not an atomic snapshot or chained joins; pages can still be incomplete.

Reference: https://api-docs.igdb.com/

exec: pm.test("All named query results returned", () => pm.expect(bundles.map(x => x.name)).to.have.members(["card", "releases", "languages", "duration"]));

pm.test("Every query has a bounded result array", () => bundles.forEach(x => { pm.expect(x.result).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(x.result.length).to.be.at.most(x.name === "card" ? 1 : Number(pm.variables.get("igdbPageSize"))); }));
